name: Little Rock
summary: Arkansas's capital — the high school that tested Brown v. Board, a presidential library, and a revived riverfront.

lodging.name: A River Market district hotel
lodging.blurb: Near the Clinton Library and the riverfront.

item.title: Little Rock Central High School NHS

location.name: Little Rock Central High School NHS
location.address: 2120 Daisy L Gatson Bates Dr, Little Rock, AR

item.blurb: The still-operating school where the 'Little Rock Nine' integrated in 1957 under federal troops — a moving visitor center tells the story.

item.title: Arkansas State Capitol
item.blurb: A near-scale replica of the U.S. Capitol, used as a stand-in in films.

days.label: Day 308 — The Clinton Library
days.summary: A presidential archive on the river.

item.title: William J. Clinton Presidential Library

location.name: Clinton Presidential Library
location.address: 1200 President Clinton Ave, Little Rock, AR

item.blurb: The 42nd president's library and museum, cantilevered over the Arkansas River, plus the River Market district.

rest.label: The riverfront
rest.note: The library sits on the Arkansas River with a park either side of it and a pedestrian bridge across. There is no more history today.

days.label: Day 309 — West to Hot Springs
days.summary: Into the Ouachitas and the spa town.

commute.scenicNote: Southwest into the mountains to the springs.
